Cascade is a local-first AI agent runtime: one binary that is both
the CLI surface and, via "cascade daemon run", the long-lived daemon.

Usage:
  cascade [flags]
  cascade [command]

Available Commands:
  completion     Generate shell completion scripts
  config         Inspect and edit cascade's config.toml
  daemon         Manage the cascade daemon process
  doctor         Diagnose the local cascade installation
  help           Help about any command
  mcp            Serve the policy-filtered MCP tool registry
  memory         Remember, recall and forget memory records
  status         One-shot summary of the running daemon
  vault          Store and retrieve secrets in the platform keychain
  version        Print the cascade version, commit, build date, and install channel

Flags:
      --config string    override the config file path
  -h, --help             help for cascade
      --json             emit output as a versioned JSON envelope
      --no-color         disable colored output (also respects NO_COLOR; see docs/cli-output-contract.md)
      --profile string   select a named config profile
  -q, --quiet            suppress progress output
  -v, --verbose          increase log verbosity

Use "cascade [command] --help" for more information about a command.
